rationale: Draft's core claims are grounded: '29 previously limited-time event quests... are now permanent and playable offline' matches chunk 1825093633183688-45 verbatim, and '9 event quests that were previously online-only have also been opened up for offline play' matches chunk 1825093633183688-42. The hedge about seasonal cosmetics ('we can't confirm whether every past seasonal cosmetic is included') is appropriately cautious given the chunks' silence on cosmetics, making this an honest read of the evidence.
